ex.en: The pyramids in Egypt are thousands of years old.
ex.zh: 埃及的金字塔已有幾千年的歷史。

ex.en: Tourists line up to enter the great pyramid.
ex.zh: 遊客們排隊要進入那座大金字塔。

ex.en: We built a small pyramid out of paper in class.
ex.zh: 我們在課堂上用紙做了一座小金字塔。

ex.en: A pyramid has a flat base and sloping sides that meet at a point.
ex.zh: 角錐有一個平坦的底面，斜邊在頂點交會。

ex.en: The students drew a pyramid in their geometry lesson.
ex.zh: 學生們在幾何課上畫了一個角錐。

ex.en: The children came downstairs in their pyjamas.
I bought a pair of warm pyjamas for winter.
ex.zh: 我買了一套冬天穿的保暖睡衣。
